meaning: A dot is worth 10 points. SCORING TABLE entry, BCD little-endian word x10 (raw 0100 -> 0x0001 -> 1 -> 10). Dossier ch.2 'The Basics'.
An energizer (power pellet) is worth 50 points. Raw 0500 -> 0x0005 -> 5 -> 50. Dossier ch.2 'The Basics'.
First ghost eaten in an energizer chain: 200 points. Raw 2000 -> 0x0020 -> 20 -> 200. Dossier ch.2 'The Basics'.
Second ghost in the same chain: 400 points (doubles). Raw 4000 -> 0x0040 -> 40 -> 400. Dossier ch.2 'The Basics'.
Third ghost in the same chain: 800 points. Raw 8000 -> 0x0080 -> 80 -> 800. Dossier ch.2 'The Basics'.
Fourth ghost in the same chain: 1600 points. Raw 6001 -> little-endian 0x0160 -> 160 -> 1600. Dossier ch.2 'The Basics'.
